Pattern: compact NR Type-I single-panel DFT codebook
Description: Compact non-table codebook is presented as NR Type-I.
RequiredProductionChange: Replace by release-pinned table/formula engine and explicit supported-profile matrix.

Description: Only rank-1 and rank-2 candidate outputs exist.
RequiredProductionChange: Implement declared ranks 1-8 or reject the unsupported rank/profile before planning.

Description: Array/codebook parameters are clamped.
RequiredProductionChange: Validate exact allowed tuples and fail without mutating N1/N2/O1/O2.

Description: Rank-2 pairing uses a generic half-grid beam offset.
RequiredProductionChange: Use the exact codebook indices, co-phasing and layer-dependent table equations.

Description: PMI is selected by raw Frobenius channel gain.
RequiredProductionChange: Use report-aware post-equalization SINR/MI/goodput objective with covariance and receiver model.

Description: PMI path has rank-1 versus rank-2 branching only.
RequiredProductionChange: Implement rank-aware candidate evaluation for every enabled Type-I/Type-II profile.

Description: Panel dimensions are inferred from the square root of the port count.
RequiredProductionChange: Require immutable antenna-panel geometry from RRC/capability state.

Description: RI selection is SVD/laboratory oriented.
RequiredProductionChange: Implement CSI-report-aware RI search maximizing the declared receiver/goodput objective.

Description: Configured SNR can enter runtime rank selection.
RequiredProductionChange: Require receiver-derived channel/noise/interference measurements.

Description: Fixed laboratory thresholds drive rank collapse.
RequiredProductionChange: Replace hard-coded thresholds by profile inputs and objective-based selection with evidence.

Description: Rank/precoder fallbacks can hide unsupported or failed selection.
RequiredProductionChange: Strict mode must reject unavailable decisions; study fallback must be explicitly labelled.

Description: CSI uses a fixed 10-bit custom container.
RequiredProductionChange: Build report-dependent CSI Part 1/Part 2 fields and TS 38.212 UCI sequences.

Description: Custom hexadecimal RI/PMI/CQI packing is used.
RequiredProductionChange: Remove custom packing from strict paths and expose bit-level field ownership.

Description: CQI can fall back to a heuristic linear mapping.
RequiredProductionChange: Use configured CQI table and link adaptation calibration only.

Description: Wideband CSI is collapsed to at most two layers.
RequiredProductionChange: Compute all enabled layer/codeword/subband metrics.

Description: Requested IRC silently becomes MMSE.
RequiredProductionChange: Strict IRC must require valid covariance and fail when unavailable.

Description: The fallback is explicitly recorded but still executed.
RequiredProductionChange: Move fallback to study-only policy outside strict receiver selection.

Description: Missing covariance starts as noise-only identity.
RequiredProductionChange: Represent unavailable covariance explicitly; do not present it as measured interference covariance.

Description: Covariance estimator has no profile-specific minimum sample support.
RequiredProductionChange: Require minimum independent samples per PRB/subband/rank and export effective sample count.

Description: Residual projection uses unqualified pseudoinverse.
RequiredProductionChange: Use rank/condition-aware residual model, shrinkage and held-out validation.

Description: Estimator catches failures and returns an unavailable/default object.
RequiredProductionChange: Strict receiver must propagate typed covariance-estimation failures.

Description: UL SRS selection is limited/defaulted to rank two and configured SNR.
RequiredProductionChange: Implement measured SRS rank/TPMI selection over the declared high-rank matrix.

Description: Type labels exist in a generic candidate generator.
RequiredProductionChange: Replace labels with exact profile-specific codebook constructors and parameter validation.

Description: Advanced codebooks are approximated using generic DFT/composite beams.
RequiredProductionChange: Implement exact Type-I multi-panel, Type-II/port-selection and selected enhanced Type-II equations.

Description: Candidate enumeration may be capped or clipped.
RequiredProductionChange: Enumerate the complete enabled candidate domain; use complexity controls only as an explicit study profile.

Description: Custom PMI field model is not the configured 3GPP report schema.
RequiredProductionChange: Serialize exact report fields, ordering, widths, conditional presence and Part-2 payload.

Description: CSI values can be clipped/wrapped into a payload.
RequiredProductionChange: Validate every field against its configured domain and fail on overflow.

Description: Beam refinement is a generic DFT sweep.
RequiredProductionChange: Drive refinement from configured CSI-RS resources, beam states, measurements and report events.

Description: Array/beam dimensions are inferred or clamped.
RequiredProductionChange: Use canonical antenna-panel and codebook objects without mutation.

Description: A heuristic parabolic pattern decides beams.
